pr_body:
close #8313, close #8832, close #6134

* [x] Add Error Type for wring Reactions
* [x] Add "Reactions List" Type ([GitHub docu](https://developer.github.com/v3/reactions/#list-reactions-for-a-commit-comment)) (Code: [Link](https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/pull/9220/files#diff-8a52179b1b9b9be4d2eee9f6548d9b0bR15-R20))
* [x] Add "Reaction Create" Type ([GitHub docu](https://developer.github.com/v3/reactions/#create-reaction-for-a-commit-comment)) (Code: [Link](https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/pull/9220/files#diff-8a52179b1b9b9be4d2eee9f6548d9b0bR11-R13))

* [x] Add API Endpoints for Comments
  - [x] `GET     /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/comments/{id}/reactions`
  - [x] `PUT     /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/comments/{id}/reactions`
  - [x] `DELETE  /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/comments/{id}/reactions`

* [x] Add API Endpoints for Issues
  - [x] `GET    /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{index}/reactions`
  - [x] `PUT    /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{index}/reactions`
  - [x] `DELETE /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{index}/reactions`

* [ ] ~~Add Reactions summary~~
  - [ ] ~~GitHub Reactions summary Type ([Link](https://developer.github.com/v3/issues/#reactions-summary))~~
  - [ ] ~~Gitea Reactions Summary Type (to support custom reactions! [Link](https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/issues/8313#issuecomment-560187778))~~

EDIT: I'll drop reactions summary for now ... if it is needed feel free to send a PR or write me a message :D

* [x] add Integration Tests
 - delete not allwed reaction
 - add not allwed reaction
 - delete reaction
 - add allowed reaction
 - get reactions
* [x] fix/update unit Tests
